entries.title: Hebrews 10:1
segments: The Law, though able to foreshadow the Better System which was coming, never had its actual substance. Its priests, with those sacrifices which they offer continuously year after year, can never make those who come to worship perfect.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:2
segments: Otherwise, would not the offering of these sacrifices have been abandoned, as the worshipers, having been once purified, would have had their consciences clear from sins?

entries.title: Hebrews 10:3
segments: But, on the contrary, these sacrifices recall their sins to mind year after year.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:4
segments: For the blood of bulls and goats is powerless to remove sins.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:5
segments: That is why, when he was coming into the world, the Christ declared-- 'Sacrifice and offering thou dost not desire, but thou dost provide for me a body;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:6
segments: Thou dost take no pleasure in burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:7
segments: So I said, "See, I have come' (as is written of me in the pages of the Book), "To do thy will, O God." '

entries.title: Hebrews 10:8
segments: First come the words-- ' Thou dost not desire, nor dost thou take pleasure in, sacrifices, offerings, burnt offerings, and sacrifices for sin' (offerings regularly made under the Law),

entries.title: Hebrews 10:9
segments: and then there is added-- 'See, I have come to do thy will.' The former sacrifices are set aside to be replaced by the latter.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:10
segments: And it is in the fulfilment of the will of God that we have been purified by the sacrifice, once and for all, of the body of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:11
segments: Every other priest stands day after day at his ministrations, and offers the same sacrifices over and over again--sacrifices that can never take sins away.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:12
segments: But, this priest, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins, which should serve for all time, 'took his seat at the right hand of God,'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:13
segments: and has since then been waiting 'for his enemies to be put as a stool for his feet.'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:14
segments: By a single offering he has made perfect for all time those who are being purified.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:15
segments: We have also the testimony of the Holy Spirit. For, after saying--

entries.title: Hebrews 10:16
segments: ' "This is the Covenant that I will make with them after those days," says the Lord; "I will impress my laws on their hearts, and will inscribe them on their minds," '

entries.title: Hebrews 10:17
segments: then we have-- 'And their sins and their iniquities I will no longer remember.'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:18
segments: And, when these are forgiven, there is no further need of an offering for sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:19
segments: Therefore, Brothers, since we may enter the Sanctuary with confidence, in virtue of the blood of Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:20
segments: by the way which he inaugurated for us--a new and living way, a way through the Sanctuary Curtain (that is, his human nature);

entries.title: Hebrews 10:21
segments: and, since we have in him 'a great priest set over the House of God,'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:22
segments: let us draw near to God in all sincerity of heart and in perfect faith, with our hearts purified by the sprinkled blood from all consciousness of wrong, and with our bodies washed with pure water.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:23
segments: Let us maintain the confession of our hope unshaken, for he who has given us his promise will not fail us.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:24
segments: Let us vie with one another in a rivalry of love and noble actions.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:25
segments: And let us not, as some do, cease to meet together; but, on the contrary, let us encourage one another, and all the more, now that you see the Day drawing near.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:26
segments: Remember, if we sin willfully after we have gained a full knowledge of the Truth, there can be no further sacrifice for sin;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:27
segments: there is only a fearful anticipation of judgement, and a burning indignation which will destroy all opponents.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:28
segments: When a man disregarded the Law of Moses, he was, on the evidence of two or three witnesses, put to death without pity.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:29
segments: How much worse then, think you, will be the punishment deserved by those who have trampled underfoot the Son of God, who have treated the blood that rendered the Covenant valid--the very blood by which they were purified--as of no account, and who have outraged the Spirit of Love?

entries.title: Hebrews 10:30
segments: We know who it was that said-- 'It is for me to avenge, I will requite'; and again-- 'The Lord will judge his people.'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:31
segments: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the Living God.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:32
segments: Call to mind those early days in which, after you had received the Light, you patiently underwent a long and painful conflict.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:33
segments: Sometimes, in consequence of the taunts and injuries heaped upon you, you became a public spectacle; and sometimes you suffered through having shown yourselves to be the friends of men who were in the very position in which you had been.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:34
segments: For you not only sympathized with those who were in prison, but you even took the confiscation of your possessions joyfully, knowing, as you did, that you had in yourselves a greater possession and a lasting one.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:35
segments: Do not, therefore, abandon the confidence that you have gained, for it has a great reward awaiting it.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:36
segments: You still have need of patient endurance, in order that, when you have done God's will, you may obtain the fulfillment of his promise.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:37
segments: 'For there is indeed but a very little while ere He who is coming will have come, without delay;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:38
segments: And through faith the Righteous man shall find his Life, But, if a man draws back, my heart can find no pleasure in him.'

entries.title: Hebrews 10:39
segments: But we do not belong to those who draw back, to their Ruin, but to those who have faith, to the saving of their souls.
